Filed as general, not tournament: the post names the Worlds result but says the X-wing Laser Cannon is a new addition; the Trandosite Worlds list ([[1999 Decipher World Championship Martin Akesson LS]]) has BoShek and Transmission Terminated x3 and no X-wing Laser Cannon.

Posted 'Han with blasterrifle' dested Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol (the only Enhanced Premiere Han; no Han blaster-rifle card existed); 'the X-wing cannon' X-wing Laser Cannon; 'jp enterance cavern' Jabba's Palace: Entrance Cavern; 'Cantina X2' Tatooine: Cantina (x2 as posted); 'the planet that is fahrthest from' The Planet That It's Farthest From; 'What are you trying to push on us' What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?.
player_note: The post says 'this deck went 2-2 the first day of the worlds' (the [[1999 Decipher World Championship]]), but the posted list is a later version: 'the X-wing gun is a new addition to get dengar in p. away.' The Worlds list itself is [[1999 Decipher World Championship Martin Akesson LS]] (from Trandosite).
